title: Move Chatticus environments from the legacy account into the chatticus-* accounts
description:
The AWS reorganization (bc4fd7, 2026-09-30) created empty member accounts chatticus-production, chatticus-staging and chatticus-development under a new Organization with Identity Center. Chatticus still runs entirely in the legacy account (ThinTurn, Web, Auth per environment, shared Snapshots/Computers, DNS, Budgets, GitHub OIDC deploy roles). Ids and CLI profiles are in AGENTS.local.md.

Moving is a real migration, not a setting:
- cdk bootstrap each new account; GitHub OIDC deploy role per account; repoint the nine deploy workflows (AWS_DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN per GitHub environment).
- Data: DynamoDB messaging tables, Cognito user pools (users cannot be exported with passwords; Google federation re-links by email), S3 snapshot buckets.
- DNS: chattic.us hosted zone and ACM certificates; decide which account owns the zone.
- The customer role template trusts one Anthus account id (AnthusAccountId); decide which account customers trust and publish accordingly.
- Shared stacks ChatticusSnapshots/ChatticusComputers are not per-environment today.
- Budgets and cost tags: per-account budgets replace the whole-account one on legacy; activate chatticus:* tags from the new management account (d706d7).
Suggested order: development first as the proving ground, then staging, then production. Do not touch legacy resources until the new environment is verified.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Progress 2026-10-19: development moved into the production AWS account (PR 610, PR 611); nine *Development stacks healthy; develop.chattic.us and auth-develop.chattic.us served from it; development GitHub environment repointed; deploy workflows green with smoke tests; dev computer image tag promoted. Development was down about one hour and came back fresh (no data carried over). The old chatticus-development account was wiped of Chatticus resources (only CDK bootstrap remains). All three environments now share the production account. Staging and development deploy roles are least-privilege; production's remains AdministratorAccess (chatticus-e49160). Remaining: legacy retirement (chatticus-c7e113), per-environment bootstrap isolation, zone move (chatticus-4e4819).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Legacy retirement 2026-10-25: deleted ChatticusAuthStaging, ChatticusAuthProduction, ChatticusThinTurnStaging in the legacy account. Remaining legacy Chatticus stacks and the blocking reasons are in chatticus-c7e113. Dev DNS records dev.chattic.us and auth-dev.chattic.us in the management zone must be removed or repointed before ChatticusWeb, ChatticusAuth and ChatticusThinTurn can retire.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Legacy retirement 2026-10-26: dev.chattic.us and auth-dev.chattic.us records removed from the management chattic.us zone (backup saved locally, details in chatticus-c7e113); legacy ChatticusWeb and ChatticusAuth stacks deleted; live sites verified 200 throughout. ChatticusThinTurn is the only legacy dev stack left; it was skipped because its recent front-door traffic was an unknown scanner rather than proven own traffic.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Legacy retirement 2026-10-26: ChatticusThinTurn (legacy dev) deleted after an on-demand table backup; all legacy dev stacks (Web, Auth, ThinTurn) are now gone and live sites kept returning 200. Details in chatticus-c7e113.

right_now_summary: Development is live in the new account; budget setup, production cutover, and legacy retirement remain.
